transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we're here to discuss the prior-learning credit petition from the student who's seeking college credit based on their work experience in biological laboratory operations. Before I make my binding decision, I'd like to follow our standard process. Could we hear from the faculty assessor regarding their report, and from the registrar regarding the records review? I want to make sure we have all the necessary information before we finalize this decision ahead of the student's upcoming transcript review.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed the faculty assessment this week. The portfolio and observed practical together demonstrate the competencies for exactly 6 credits. However, I want to be clear that this credit recommendation is valid only if the observed practical is included alongside the portfolio — the portfolio alone would not be sufficient to support the credit recommendation.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: During my records review, I confirmed in the state articulation record that these competencies must be posted as a course equivalency for BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, rather than as general biology elective credit or a letter grade.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Credit is awarded based on the portfolio and observed practical together; the portfolio alone would not have been sufficient.
Credits must be posted as a course equivalency for BIO-115 with a CR transcript notation, per the state articulation record.
